purpose: Records how the two generated D1 documents were restored, and states precisely what that evidence does and does not prove.
meaning_of_pinned_digests: Forward integrity baseline only. These digests were computed AFTER restoration and are not evidence of the unknown historical pre-D2 checksum. Any future drift from them is detectable; agreement with the true pre-D2 files is asserted nowhere.
approved_wording: Restored by reversing the known D2 insertion; the original pre-D2 digest was unavailable, so exact historical byte identity cannot be independently proven. The resulting files are pinned from D3 onward.
why_original_was_unavailable: The .d2_before.json snapshot recording pre-D2 digests was deleted during D2 cleanup.
